verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists a first-party "Mobile SDK (add-on)", and it also documents a Web API, so official developer surfaces exist. The SDK appears only as a single line item, with no language coverage, SDK reference docs, or usage detail, and it is a paid add-on. Missing for 10: SDK documentation and language/platform coverage, general-purpose (non-mobile) SDKs for the Web API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
